name: Software Engineering
description: Designs, builds, tests, and maintains software applications and systems.
responsibilities: Write automated tests and review code
Collaborate with a team using version control
typical_education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
employment_outlook: Faster than average growth projected over the next decade
source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook

name: Data Science / Artificial Intelligence
description: Builds models and systems that learn from data to support prediction, classification, and automated decision-making.
responsibilities: Clean and analyze structured and unstructured data
Design, train, and evaluate machine learning models
Communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
typical_education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or related field
employment_outlook: Much faster than average growth projected over the next decade
source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook

name: Robotics
description: Develops software and systems that let machines sense, plan, and act in the physical world.
responsibilities: Implement perception, planning, and control software
Integrate sensors and actuators with software systems
Test autonomous behavior in simulation and hardware
typical_education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, or Electrical/Computer Engineering
employment_outlook: Faster than average growth projected over the next decade
source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook
